ingest.note: Accepts text (with language/speaker params) via WebSocket streaming or REST API.

egress.note: Output codec configurable: wav, mp3, aac. Sample rate configurable 8000-48000 Hz (default 24000). Optimized for Indian languages.

potholes.note: Sarvam TTS is optimized for Indian languages but may have higher latency than Cartesia/ElevenLabs for English. Use the WebSocket streaming API (not REST) for real-time.
Sarvam defaults to 24000 Hz output. Telephony leg needs 8000 Hz μ-law — set speech_sample_rate=8000 or resample + encode yourself.

interruption.description: On interruption, stop the TTS streaming session. Discard buffered audio.
interruption.code_hint: Close the WebSocket and clear output buffer.
